name: Perseverance raw images (Navcam and Mastcam-Z)
product: Raw images feed, cameras NAVCAM_LEFT and MCZ_LEFT (full frames)
licence: Public domain. Credit NASA/JPL-Caltech (Navcam) and NASA/JPL-Caltech/ASU (Mastcam-Z).
notes: From https://mars.nasa.gov/rss/api/?feed=raw_images&category=mars2020&feedtype=json . One to three frames per place, taken while the rover was parked there, resized to 1200 px wide WebP. Raw frames: colours are as the camera recorded them, not calibrated. Each photo keeps its NASA image id and link.
